Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Symptomatic patients with recent neurological events (TIA or non-disabling stroke) with an associated carotid stenosis greater than or equal to 50% by angiography or greater than or equal to 70% by ultrasound or greater than or equal to 70% by Computed Tomography Angiography (CTA) or Magnetic Resonance Angiography (MRA) are eligible for randomization.
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: Patient description contains no mention of neurological events (TIA/stroke) or carotid stenosis measurements.

Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Asymptomatic patients with no recent (in the last 6 months) neurological events referable to the study with artery and carotid stenosis (patients with symptoms beyond 180 days are considered asymptomatic) greater than or equal to 60% by angiography or greater than or equal to 70% by ultrasound or greater than or equal to 80% by CTA or MRA are eligible for randomization.
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: Patient description contains no mention of carotid stenosis measurements or neurological event history.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Conditions that: (1) interfere with the evaluation of endpoints, (2) are known to interfere with the completion of CEA or CAS, or (3) affect the likelihood of survival for the study period (4 years).
Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: Patient has multiple cardiovascular comorbidities (coronary artery disease, ischemic cardiomyopathy), but criteria do not specify which conditions qualify as exclusionary.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Chronic atrial fibrillation and/or anti-coagulation or episodic atrial fibrillation within the last 6 months.
Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: Patient description contains no mention of atrial fibrillation or anti-coagulation therapy.

Recap: Patient lacks data on carotid stenosis or neurological events (required for inclusion). No exclusionary conditions (atrial fibrillation) are present, but general exclusion criteria remain unclear due to unspecified comorbidities.
